questions.question: How is 45 Paise expressed in Rupees using decimal notation?
questions.explanation: Since 1 Rupee = 100 Paise, 1 Paise = ₹0.01. Therefore, 45 Paise = 45 / 100 = ₹0.45.

questions.question: One millimeter represents ____ of a centimeter.
questions.explanation: 1 cm = 10 mm, so 1 mm = 1/10 cm = 0.1 cm.

questions.question: Find the difference in length between Celestial Pearl Danio (2.4 cm) and Philippine Goby (0.9 cm).
Explain using place value principles why 0.2 is strictly greater than 0.09, despite 9 being larger than 2.
questions.explanation: Comparing digits from left to right: 0.2 has a digit of 2 in the tenths position (2/10), whereas 0.09 has 0 in the tenths position (0/10) and 9 in the hundredths position (9/100). Expressed with equivalent denominators, 0.2 = 20/100 while 0.09 = 9/100. Since 20/100 > 9/100, 0.2 > 0.09.
